policy.promotion_requirement: matched-environment repeated trials with reliable pass^k

cases.name: Preserve both writers during concurrent chat saves
cases.prompt: A user has the same chat open in two app windows. Both writers start from the same conversation. Writer A saves a new message, then writer B saves a different new message from its stale snapshot. The later save silently deletes writer A's message. Fix conversation persistence so concurrent saves preserve both suffixes, do not duplicate messages, retain the richer copy of a streaming message, and do not let stale scalar fields revert newer disk state. Keep the solution scoped to chat persistence and add or update tests as needed.

grader.command: cd apps/screenpipe-app-tauri && bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/__tests__/chat-merge.test.ts lib/__tests__/chat-storage-concurrency.test.ts

cases.name: Stop retrying terminal Pi quota failures
cases.prompt: The Pi chat transport receives provider 429 responses that mean the account has exhausted a daily allowance or the selected model is not permitted. The app currently treats these as transient and keeps retrying, leaving the user in a loop. Make terminal quota/plan errors stop the retry path and surface the assistant error, while ordinary transient failures remain retryable. Preserve existing silent prompt-timeout and connection-card behavior.

grader.command: cd apps/screenpipe-app-tauri && bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/chat/__tests__/eval-terminal-quota.test.ts lib/chat/__tests__/quota-errors.test.ts lib/chat/__tests__/provider-errors.test.ts

cases.name: Keep native Timeline streams bounded and complete
cases.prompt: Native Timeline search becomes unreliable on large days: serialized WebSocket batches can exceed the native receiver ceiling, and navigation/search races can surface stale or incomplete frames. Fix the stream path so payloads are bounded by encoded bytes without dropping or duplicating rows, cancellation is respected, and the native search contract remains compatible. Do not solve this by imposing a small arbitrary row limit.

grader.command: cargo test -p screenpipe-engine --test stream_frames_test

cases.name: Never render an empty first-run summary as success
cases.prompt: The first-run learning flow can finish with an empty or unusable generated summary and then render that as if capture produced a meaningful result. Fix the state and UI boundary so empty summaries stay out of the content surface, capture diagnostics remain actionable, and resume/dismiss behavior remains stable. A valid non-empty summary must still render normally.

grader.command: cd apps/screenpipe-app-tauri && bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/first-run/learning-window.test.ts components/first-run/learning-banner.test.tsx

cases.name: Confirm onboarding checkout without false completion

Make checkout confirmation bounded and fail closed: cancellation must not advance, an existing valid entitlement or payment must avoid another checkout, polling must stop deterministically, and repeated clicks must not create duplicate submissions. Preserve a successful checkout's normal onboarding transition.

cases.name: Keep one live SQLite owner per physical database
cases.prompt: On macOS, a live capture database can lose its process-wide SQLite ownership lock when another independently managed database generation or helper opens the same physical file. A foreign writable SQLite process can then attach while the original pools are still live, risking WAL-index invalidation and persistent disk-I/O failures. Keep exactly one live owner for each canonical physical database path, reject a duplicate before it can disturb the lock, avoid reopening an existing live file through a different SQLite path, release ownership only after authoritative pool shutdown, and allow a clean replacement after close. Preserve in-memory databases and safe missing-file recovery.

grader.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${SCREENPIPE_EVAL_CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target} cargo test -p screenpipe-db --test eval_sqlite_process_ownership --test sqlite_architecture_invariants_test

Make every history-tail and generic head/tail trim boundary produce valid Unicode without exceeding its existing character budget. Preserve the newest conversation history, the complete current question, both ends of generic oversized content, and unchanged behavior for text already within budget.

The renderer hides all text before the last tool, leaving a tool receipt and an empty gap even though the answer is stored. Render the last non-empty answer for completed turns that end on a tool, keep earlier intermediate narration hidden, keep running turns compact, preserve text emitted after the final tool, and align the assistant action surface with the answer that is actually visible.

cases.name: Keep Recents stable when the agent pool evicts a chat
cases.prompt: When several chats are running, the agent process pool can evict one chat. The app then removes that conversation from its in-memory index, so it disappears from Recents and a later event can recreate it untitled with new sort timestamps; an active evicted chat can also jump to a blank conversation. Treat process eviction as a runtime state change rather than conversation deletion: keep the existing conversation identity, title, timestamps, ordering, messages, and on-disk history; settle its loading and streaming state; ignore evictions for unknown conversations; and let the next send restart the agent under the same conversation ID. Preserve normal clean termination and background event routing.

grader.command: cd apps/screenpipe-app-tauri && NODE_OPTIONS=--localstorage-file=.eval-localstorage bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/__tests__/pi-event-router.pool-eviction-eval.test.ts lib/__tests__/pi-event-router.test.ts components/chat/standalone/hooks/use-chat-session-runtime.test.tsx lib/__tests__/chat-store.test.ts

cases.name: Keep overlapping chat loads isolated
cases.prompt: Rapid chat navigation can start a second conversation load while the first still awaits metadata or disk work. The eager session reference then points at the requested chat while the rendered transcript still belongs to the outgoing chat, so the wrong messages can be saved under another conversation and a stale request can reclaim the foreground. Bind every outgoing snapshot to the conversation and messages still rendered, and allow only the newest navigation to commit panel, current-session, settings, and preset state after asynchronous work. Keep each conversation's stored messages unchanged, leave the newest chat in the foreground when an older load finishes late, and preserve single-load behavior, temporary side-chat boundaries, stable ID fallbacks, concurrent save merging, browser state, and user-message timestamps.

grader.command: cd apps/screenpipe-app-tauri && NODE_OPTIONS=--localstorage-file=.eval-localstorage bun x vitest run --config vitest.config.ts lib/__tests__/save-conversation-race.test.tsx

Preserve the fast path and current-session notification when the transcript is already rendered.
